title: Backfill runtime verifier capabilities from repeated STT/TTS route aborts
mission: Convert the repeated STT/TTS host-boundary returns into preclaim routing metadata instead of spending PIN generations on workers that cannot perform the required browser/public-network checks. Patch only the affected derived-job capability declarations and the allocator/compiler regression coverage needed to preserve them.
definition_of_done: TTS generic-text browser smoke requires representative_javascript_browser and browser_network_navigation_to_github_pages before claim.

TTS served/public-HTTP verification and existing-cache GET verification expose an explicit machine-checkable public-network/DNS capability; if the taxonomy lacks one, add one durably with allocator tests rather than encoding host guesses in worker prose.
STT representative runtime verification advertises the browser/network capabilities needed for the microphone/selftest route and does not route to connector-only workers that cannot execute it.
A worker definitively lacking a required capability skips preclaim without consuming a PIN generation.
Run the fast-allocation capability-fit and efficiency-ratchet regressions; do not weaken existing routing guards.
